# Paddock Times

> An unofficial Formula 1 statistics app: championship standings, race calendar
> and results, driver & team career profiles, head-to-head comparisons, past-race
> telemetry and lap-by-lap session replays. Data from f1db (CC-BY 4.0) and OpenF1.

## Pages

- [Standings](https://paddocktimes.com/standings): drivers' and constructors' championship tables for any season (1950–present)
- [Calendar](https://paddocktimes.com/calendar): race calendar, winners and full weekend results, including sprints
- [Circuits](https://paddocktimes.com/circuits): every F1 circuit with track length, turns, race lap record, layouts and winners
- [Drivers](https://paddocktimes.com/drivers): driver profiles with full career stats, plus a searchable index since 1950
- [Teams](https://paddocktimes.com/teams): constructor profiles and a searchable index of every team since 1950
- [Compare](https://paddocktimes.com/compare): head-to-head driver comparison, overall or for a single season
- [Live](https://paddocktimes.com/live): live timing and lap-by-lap replays of past races and sprints (2023+)
- [Telemetry](https://paddocktimes.com/telemetry): speed, throttle, brake and DRS traces from past races

## Notes

- F1, FORMULA 1 and related marks are trademarks of Formula One Licensing B.V. This is an unofficial, non-commercial fan project.
